messages:
dana: heads up — onboarding mixtral-8b-legacy (hf) hit a perf regression in runtime. parser fell back to scalar kernel because safetensors lacked kv metadata; p95 token latency ~2.4x higher than baseline.

ben: ouch. can you paste the parser warning / log?

dana: ```WARNING runtime.hfparser: safetensors metadata missing 'kv_head_dim'. inferring kv dims -> mismatch with model.num_heads. falling back to 'scalar_rope' kernel. commit=fa3b2c7```

carla: repro steps? i can triage quickly. is this during conversion or at serve time?

dana: at serve time — conversion produced a safetensors blob w/o extra metadata. quick repro: `python convert_hf.py --model mixtral-8b-legacy --out model.safetensors` then start serve and `curl` generate with prompt ~200 tokens. profile attached in thread.

sam: quick theory: mixtral uses rope_scaling and nonstandard head/kv layout; if kv_head_dim is missing parser shouldn't default to 1:1 naive shape. leads to head dim mismatch and runtime picks generic (correct) but slow attention path.

ben: profile snippet?

dana: ```perf report (canary):
  scalar_attention_kernel  68.3%  
  memory_copy             12.1%  
  fast_batched_kernel     7.4%   <-- expected
  other                   12.2%
  p95 token latency: 87ms (was 36ms)
```

carla: thanks. actionable: 1) parser should infer kv_head_dim = hidden_size / num_heads if safetensors missing and divisible, 2) add strict linter warning during onboarding, 3) add a tiny unit test that simulates missing metadata so we don't regress. I'll open a PR.

sam: also double-check rope_scaling field. i saw a model where rope_scaling=0.5 in config but conversion wrote 1.0 into metadata -> mismatch. that plus kv mismatch amplifies kernel selection heuristics.

ben: runtime batching heuristics note: current min_contiguous_tokens threshold = 64. for small head dims we saw better utilization raising to 128 helps keep fast kernel chosen. but that increases tail latency for tiny requests. need to balance.

carla: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123 — parser fallback for kv_head_dim + onboarding linter. includes unit and e2e harness.

dana: nice. i'll test canary with PR build. also let's add a perf test in ci that runs mixtral-8b-legacy through fast path check (assert fast_batched_kernel > 30%).

infra-bot: deploy of runtime/pr-4123 to canary cluster started — job id 78912 :rocket:

ben: after canary, we should update conversion docs and add a conversion flag `--emit-kv-meta` to avoid this in future.

sam: agree. i'll add a follow-up issue to update `tools/convert` and include safetensors metadata validation on `redwood model add`.

carla: follow-up issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/998 — also added checklist item for rope_scaling consistency.

dana: thanks all — assigned to carla for PR and sam for conversion flags. will monitor canary perf and report back here. :thumbsup:
